sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: In all probability, today you will discover that your family is the foundation of your success, predicts Ganesha. Your dearly loved spouse may try to spice up the relationship in the afternoon and you will be more than willing to reciprocate, expects Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Yes, Taurus, this is a good moment to abandon old beliefs and moral values. Your view of life has changed and, above all, you're more aware of how your outdated, preconceived ideas sometimes poison your life. The past no longer concerns you. It's time for you to make a clean break from the beliefs that are holding you back. You might shock your family, but they'll get over it.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Devote your Saturday morning to releasing stress and living your best life, darling Taurus. As the Libra Moon aligns with Venus RX, Jupiter, the nodes of fate, and Chiron, you're probably due for some serious pampering. Lay low to avoid overstimulation, skipping bustling crowds and long brunch lines. If you're dealing with a full household, have everyone pitch in to prepare breakfast and assist with cleanup. Your softer side shines through once Luna enters Scorpio midafternoon, balancing your aura and creating a sense of levity. Cut ties with anyone or anything that tries to steal your peace when Pluto grows restless later tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: A very good day from health point of view. Your cheerful state of mind will give you the desired tonic and keep you confident. Someone with big plans and ideas will catch your attention- Verify the credibility and authenticity of the person before making any investments. Give priorities to the needs of family members. Involve yourself to share their joy and sorrow to realize them that you care for them. You can spend time with an elder of the family today to understand the intricacies of life. After many ups and downs in your married life, today is the golden day to cherish your love for each other. Don't worry about what other people think or perceive about you. Just make sure to make the right decisions, and nothing will come your way.

readings.text: Today, the start of the day may not be as bright as the shining Sun. However, you may get gradually occupied in completing your tasks. It will be a stressful day in the office. Plan carefully otherwise you may end up getting exhausted. A proactive approach can help you fetch some good deals from the customers.

Don't expect people to pull through for you the way you want them to. People are rather flighty today and won't remember a thing that you have said. It will most likely go in one ear and out the other. Don't put your full trust in others.
Ganesha advises you to go in for a thorough medical check up to determine your exact health status, even if it is expensive, which will show you what line of treatment, if needed, you should follow.

This week, you have positive and negative news about your financial life. If you've been true to your goals and kept within budget, this planet provides new opportunities to make more money. If you've overspent, sudden and perhaps unexpected changes in your career sector could mean that what you counted on to cover bills may not be there. Saving for the future can get you through this time.

bits.t: If you're dealing with a full household, have everyone pitch in to prepare breakfast and assist with cleanup.
Someone with big plans and ideas will catch your attention- Verify the credibility and authenticity of the person before making any investments.
You can spend time with an elder of the family today to understand the intricacies of life.

readings.text: Just like a busy bee, you shall move around in your office to complete all the undone tasks. Yet, you will not get bored or tired, simply because you shall be overflowing with lots of energy and enthusiasm, foresees Ganesha.

With today's astral energies at play, you may feel extra sensitive. If you don't know what you think or feel, perhaps you could take some time to yourself and do something relaxing. Take your mind off the job, the kids, the spouse, the boss - and spend some time getting distracted in a healthy way. Definitely exercise, definitely drink a lot of water. The balancing act of separating what you want from what others want will be easier if you give yourself some extra room.

Cut ties with anyone or anything that tries to steal your peace when Pluto grows restless later tonight.
A very good day from health point of view.

lucky.remedy: Creating problems for any auspicious event such as marriage will weaken Venus. So, for a stable and secure financial status, desist from such acts.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: You're well suited for physical activity today -- build or create something real.
